reply.text: That's a question for a doctor or physio, not me — a hamstring strain can range from minor to the kind that needs real imaging, and I don't want to guess wrong on something that could get worse with the wrong movement. Get it looked at, and once you've got a clear picture of what you're dealing with, I'll help you train around it. Want me to adjust your program in the meantime so nothing aggravates it?
